newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KPW CLEARS BROKERAGE SALE TO HSBC.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KPW CLEARS BROKERAGE SALE TO HSBC.

text.p: Polish Securities Commission on Tuesday cleared the sale of a majority stake in Dom Inwestycyjny Guziejewski and Albrecht SA brokerage house to HSBC Investment Bank Holdings BV, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc.
Hubert Janiszewski, the dirctor of HSBC's Polish unit, told a news conference that his company planned to increase the brokerage's capital so that it could become member of the Warsaw Stock Exchange.
He said HSBC still needed to secure a go ahead for the purchase from the government's Consumer Protection Office, an anty-monopoly watchdog.

"After KPW's decision there is one more condition to be met...," Janiszewski said, adding his company would eventually seek to buy 100 percent of the house's shares. He did not name the majority stake HSBC was planning to buy.
The brokerage house netted 200,000 zlotys last year.
